cards.p: Login window, signed reboot, keep defaults. The machine is supposed to feel strict.
Updates are automatic and signed. Check status, reboot, roll back if a bake is bad.

cards.h3: Check the box is what we shipped
cards.p: Status, overlay audit, stock audit, cosign. Five minutes, no extra software.
Graphical session as a non-admin. run0 when you need privilege. That is the standard.
No GUI store. Verified Flathub, then Flatpak. Lockdown stays; grant in Flatseal.
USBGuard: allow what is plugged in now, block the rest. Do this once, on purpose.
Off on purpose. Wi-Fi is already on. Turn BT on only if you need it.
Kernel lock and browser policy are two different doors. Open the smallest one.
Extra sandbox blocks capture. Loosen that pack, not the whole browser.
Usually JIT-less or WebGL. That is a lock. Do not flatten every policy for one page.
Security first. Extra browser packs make you rarer than stock Trivalent. Phone-home off does not. Blend only if you choose.
Keep system DNS on the VPN’s resolver. Skip Trivalent DoH if you tunnel.
Off. Prefer Flatpak. Turn the wrappers back into real bins only when you need a pet container.
